slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Leader | 21 Years in Software, DevOps & AI-Driven Engineering
slides.n: Welcome to {name}'s career journey. {He} is a PMP-certified engineering leader with 21 years of progressive experience, including 8 years in engineering management, spanning software development, testing, DevOps, and AI-enabled transformation.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, drove a 90% reduction in upgrade time, security hardening, and built 7-8 agentic AI agents for CVE remediation and bug resolution.

Cisco Systems · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Led Webex developer experience team, architected distributed presence/calling integration between Webex and Microsoft Teams using Kafka, Redis and Java, and drove AI-based code generation for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led developers, testers and release engineers on Cisco Expressway, driving Python/C++ platform features, Erlang-based DB upgrades, and DevOps release/build improvements.

Cisco Systems · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Owned functional, regression and automation testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, handled customer escalations with SIP/SCCP/H.323 troubleshooting, and drove automation coverage toward 100%.
Verizon & Alcatel · May 2007-Apr 2008 — Performed call-flow, functional and regression testing for IP contact center and Alcatel OmniPCX PBX solutions across multiple releases.
slides.n: {His} journey spans two decades, starting in QA testing for VoIP and PBX systems, growing into team leadership at Cisco, and now leading AI-driven engineering transformation at F5, where {he} manages control plane security and automation initiatives.

Over the years, {name} has built deep expertise across engineering leadership, VoIP protocols, distributed systems architecture, and more recently, agentic AI and GenAI tools, applying them hands-on to accelerate delivery and strengthen security.

items: Reduction in upgrade time at F5
Test automation coverage achieved at Cisco Expressway
slides.n: {His} impact is measurable — from cutting upgrade times by 90 percent at F5, to resolving over 100 long-lived defects and CVEs, to driving automation coverage to 100 percent during {his} QA years at Cisco.

{His} foundation includes a B.E. in Electronics and Communication, a PMP certification, and a recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Texas at Austin, reflecting {his} continued growth into AI-driven leadership.
That concludes {name}'s career overview — a journey from hands-on QA engineering to AI-driven engineering leadership. Thank you for taking the time to learn about {his} experience and impact.
